title: saferMatrix 2.0.0
text: Migrated safer-r backbone v20.0: 5 functions (mat_fill, mat_inv, mat_num2color, mat_op, mat_rotate) now follow saferDev 2.0.0 structure, arg_check() v2.0.0 semantics (exact class/typeof/mode comparison; class = c(“matrix”, “array”) matrices, prop = TRUE [0,1] proportion arguments, mode = “numeric” preferred numeric arguments). functions carry mandatory lib_path, safer_check error_text reserved arguments. Internal functions (.base_op_check, .pack_and_function_check) now imported saferDev (>= 2.0.0) instead duplicated locally; internal_functions.R man page removed. Bug fixes found migration: mat_op now restores row column names identical across matrices mat.list; mat_num2color longer crashes integer matrices mat.hsv.h = TRUE (clear error message instead). Complete test suite rewritten saferDev style (tests/testthat), including test-mandatory_args.R replicating saferDev pattern; code coverage brought 100% # nocov markers unreachable internal-error branches.
